entities.name: Cross-Border Telehealth Platform
entities.description: A cross-border telehealth platform delivering video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients with strict regional data residency and compliance using GCP.

entities.name: Patients
entities.description: EU & US patients seeking video consultations, e-prescriptions, and AI symptom checks.

entities.name: Licensed Clinicians
entities.description: Medical professionals providing video consultations and issuing e-prescriptions.

entities.name: External Pharmacies
entities.description: EU national gateways and US pharmacy networks.

entities.name: Regional Identity & Consent Providers
entities.description: eIDAS/EU login and US IAM managing identity and consent.

entities.name: AI Model Providers / Medical Devices
entities.description: External AI inference APIs powering the AI symptom checker.

entities.name: Patient Web/Mobile App
entities.description: Powers the Patient Web/Mobile App with local state caching for unstable connections.

entities.name: API Gateway & Routing Service
entities.description: Manages API gateway routing, Istio service mesh mTLS, and Canary deployments.

entities.name: Core Telehealth Service
entities.description: Powers the Core Telehealth Service handling consultations and consent.

entities.name: E-Prescription Interoperability Service
entities.description: Powers the E-Prescription Interoperability Service translating HL7 FHIR and national EU standards.

entities.name: AI Symptom Checker Service
entities.description: Powers the AI Symptom Checker Service with local PII/PHI masking.

entities.name: Database Cluster
entities.description: Regional data stores secured with Google Cloud KMS CMEK.
